summary: The act of noticing can become the metaphor of awakening. The ordinary word 覺 should not automatically be read as technical Buddhist enlightenment.
placement: Selected from a numerically integrated sprott trajectory to distribute stars across its projected shape. This is an artistic placement, not linguistic evidence.

satellites.title: Noticing and Awakening
satellites.evidence: The same character appears in terms for noticing and awakening. The distinction is a difference of usage, not evidence that the experiences are identical.

satellites.title: Right Awakening
satellites.evidence: 覺 renders bodhi, awakening, and 正覺 renders sambodhi, full awakening. In the Sutra of Immeasurable Life the vows end one after another with 不取正覺, “may I not take right awakening” unless the vow is fulfilled.

checked.note: 設我得佛，國有地獄、餓鬼、畜生者，不取正覺 — the formula recurs through the vows
